text_block_list.text:
Finally, a precious day off. 
I had planned to use this day to improve
myself.

I thought that if I wanted to support Daiichi
Ruby, 
who is always striving to be the best,
I also need 
to improve myself.

I meet Daiichi Ruby at a large bookstore I
visited. 
I carry a large number of books that I
have 
bought in a variety of genres.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ……I see, for the sake of improvement?

I thought she would be appalled by the 
number of book, but that didn't happen. 
It look like she is looking for a book
too.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Today,
I came here to purchase the catalogue of 
the current art exhibition.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It was already sold out in the exhibition
hall 
where it is being held, It's this one…

Daiichi Ruby showed me a thick book
filled 
with detailed explanations along with 
photographs of the paintings.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
When I visit the exhibition,
I always ask for it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It is a great way to quickly access expert
opinions, 
the explanations and supplements are
substantial, 
it's very informative.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san also seems to have purchased
art 
history books. If you are interested,
you may 
find these catalogs helpful―

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
…It's not my intention to point it out
but, 
I see that you have already purchased quite
a few books.

It's true that I already pick up a lot of
thing. 
The expense will be considerable.
But this is also for study ……
choice_data_list: Because I want to try my best to m...
Because I want to try my best to m...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: is that so.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
…Trainer-san,
do you have plan after this? 
If you have time,
I would like to bring you somewhere.

I was allowed to ride in Daiichi Ruby's car,
after that 
we arrived at an art museum where an
exhibition 
of the catalog I had purchased is being
held.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I was planning to visit this art exhibition
today. 
Catalogs are nothing more than a stepping 
stone for understanding the works.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
There are lessons you can only learn from
seeing 
the real thing. Now, let's go.

Daiichi Ruby guided me through the
museum. 
She seemed to have done a lot of research
before, 
her explanations are very thorough.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
―All of the works on display today are by
the 
same artist, who hails from Tohoku.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The realistic brushwork and ethereal
expression 
are the essence of his work, it is highly 
regarded for its profound and subtle
style.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Also in the exhibit over there―

Even after leaving the exhibition I can
still feel the excitement. 
Thanks to Daiichi Ruby's explanation,
I feel I was able to 
appreciate the paintings more deeply.

Although I felt tired because we spent so
much 
time on each point,
but I was able to spend a 
day filled with a sense of fulfillment.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Is that so?

And I'm glad I found out who your ...

text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby lives on a minute-by-minute
schedule. 
She too spend her free time free time
enjoying 
things she likes.

I am more than happy to know that. 
That's what I was thinking―

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not particularly like this
painter.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I heard that the guest of honor at the next
gathering 
was from the same hometown as today's
artist, 
so I went to see it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I hope it will be a good conversation
piece. 
Because there are people who have a deep
knowledge of art.

Daiichi Ruby was enthusiastically taking
notes 
during the viewing.
That's why I thought that 
this is her favorite artist―
choice_data_list: All of that for just a single meeting?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I believe that meticulous preparation in
advance 
is the best form of courtesy.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Besides,
this kind of experience will be my own 
food for thought.
I want to make full use of the 
opportunity to learn.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The guideline for deciding actions is whether
it is 
necessary or not, not likes or dislikes. 
I only feel that it is "necessary" to visit
here today.

Daiichi Ruby said that and stretched her
back. I 
understood that this integrity of her is
the 
core of who she was.
Still, at that time――

It was in front of a painting of a starry
sky. 
It was unusual that she didn't say
anything, 
just looked straight at it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ……Scorpion's Fire……

Only that painting seemed to show her
something 
other than family obligations.
When I asked her 
she would not give me an answer.

After returning home.
I looked up the painting that she 
was looking at in the catalogue.
The title is "Antares" -
the heart of Scorpius, the star of summer.

Among the stars that glitter white,
there is a 
single solitary star that shines bright
red. It feel similar to her… that's what I
thought.
